name: io.github.imharikumaran/altimateguide
description: Submit a tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review, and optionally upgrade it to a dofollow listing. Review times: paid/sayabout 2 business days, badge 5-7, unverified 15-20 (nofollow).

environmentVariables.name: ALTIMATEGUIDE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional account API token. Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access), or mint one at runtime with the complete_login tool (email OTP).
